commitSubject: Compile and reflect the mask shader instead of only reading it
change: Mask shaders and cbuffer moved to src/MaskShaders.h; tests compile and reflect them; shipped-artefact checker added. Rendering behaviour unchanged.
treeBuildFieldsProvenance: Observed at deploy time from the tree build.
normalisedSource: Computed from the preserved DEPLOYED bytes, not from the backup in this directory.
freshness: plugin rebuilt after the tests; 2455 assertions / 99 cases green; pre-commit run on the changed files

pdbLink.method: SECONDARY sanity check only; byte identity is primary

symbolsContainer: PDB. C++ symbol names live in the .pdb, NOT the .dll - probing the DLL returns 0 for all of them and that 0 is not evidence the record is false. Counts must match EXACTLY, not >=.
mutationProof: Adding float2 reservedPad to the HLSL cbuffer fails cbDesc.Size in test_mask_shaders.cpp:98 while every text assertion still passes. sampled <= 0.5, maskUV <=/>=, max instead of min, and return 1.0 each fail the text case. Reordering the struct fails the offsetof comparison.
mutationProofProvenance: Recorded at deploy time. The reflection test is the one that mattered: text assertions were blind to a cbuffer that grew.
whatThisDoesNotProve: Not cross-machine reproducible: no scratch-worktree rebuild of this commit was run. The reflection test proves the compiled HLSL matches the struct; the artefact checker proves the DLL contains the literals; neither proves the runtime backend compiled them at run time on this machine.
whyThisExists: A hash records the bytes shipped, not that they came from the intended source.
backupHolds: PRE-deployment files. backup DLL is deliberately NOT equal to dllSHA256; a mismatch means the backup worked.
whyDeployedCopyExists: Every earlier deploy survives an install overwrite because a later backup/ holds it. The newest had no such record, so its bytes lived only in the live install. The deploy script now copies the installed DLL/PDB to deployed/ and fails if the copy does not match; this record is the first made by that version.
shippedShaderCheck: tools/check_shipped_shaders.py run against the deployed DLL before recording: both kVertexShader and kPixelShader literals found verbatim.
treeBuildPDBSHA256Provenance: LOST at this deploy: still absent, and not recoverable. The tree build for 9d2622a was not preserved separately from the deployed artefact, and rebuilding it now would carry a different link stamp rather than being this build. Null means lost, not failed.

postHocAnnotations.note: Added 2026-10-31T22:53:05+00:00 by HONG after the record was written, when a checker finally read the records. No measurement was invented: this string explains an existing null, and the null and every hash in the record are unchanged.
